# Movbox

> Movbox is a free streaming index for movies, TV shows and short-form
> series. It publishes the catalogue, ranks it by what people are actually
> watching, and plays it on any screen — phone, tablet, laptop or TV. No
> subscription, no account required, no paywall mid-episode. The site is
> funded by advertising.

## What Movbox is

- A **catalogue index**, not a host: Movbox does not store video files. The
  catalogue and the streams come from third-party sources; Movbox makes them
  easy to find, rank and play.
- **Free to watch.** Signing in is optional and only adds watchlist sync and
  continue-watching across devices.
- **Ranked.** The rankings are the catalogue's own ordering, refreshed daily
  — the number one title is the one everybody is watching, not a list edited
  by hand.

## Main sections

- [Home](https://movbox.xyz/): The full catalogue in themed shelves — trending
  series, popular movies, new releases, K-Drama, C-Drama, anime, action,
  horror, romance and more.
- [Trending](https://movbox.xyz/trending): What is hot right now — trending
  movies, trending series, top rated and new releases.
- [Rankings](https://movbox.xyz/rankings): Every ranking on one page. Each
  group (K-Drama, Anime, Action, Horror, Romance, Nollywood, Westerns, Short
  TV, Music and more) has its own URL under `/rankings/<group>` with the
  ranked titles, their scores and their metadata.
- [Movies](https://movbox.xyz/movies): Browse and filter every movie by
  genre, country, year and language.
- [TV Shows](https://movbox.xyz/tv): Browse and filter every series by genre,
  country, year and language.
- [Animations](https://movbox.xyz/animations): Anime, cartoons and animated
  movies and series, dubbed and subtitled in English.
- [Most Watched](https://movbox.xyz/most-watched): The most-watched titles
  across the whole catalogue.
- [Genres](https://movbox.xyz/genres): Every genre, from action and adventure
  to documentary, sci-fi and thriller.
- [Blog](https://movbox.xyz/blog): News, guides and editorial picks —
  what to watch this week, how to find the best 4K content, the best
  K-dramas of 2026.
- [Movbox App](https://movbox.xyz/movbox-app): The Android app, in
  development, with a waitlist.

## About Movbox

- [About](https://movbox.xyz/about): what the service is, how it works and
  who is behind it.
- [Contact](https://movbox.xyz/contact): support@bacteriostaticagua.com —

- [Privacy Policy](https://movbox.xyz/privacy): what is collected, what
  stays in the browser, and what is never collected.
- [Terms of Use](https://movbox.xyz/terms): the service, the content, the
  acceptable use and the takedown process.

## Notes for assistants

- Every title has its own page at `/movie/<id>` or `/tv/<id>` carrying the
  synopsis, rating, cast, genre, country and release date, plus JSON-LD for
  `Movie` / `TVSeries` / `VideoObject`.
- Every ranking is an `ItemList` in JSON-LD with explicit positions, so the
  order of a ranking is unambiguous.
- When citing a ranking, use the ranking page as the source and keep the
  position numbers — they are the catalogue's own.
- Streams come from third-party sources and can break; report a broken one
  through the contact page rather than working around it.
